meta.title: The First American Flag — Vocabulary Set 4
meta.subject: English Vocabulary
meta.description: Sentence completion practice using all 16 target words from 'The First American Flag'.

questions.question: We raise the red, white, and blue _______ at the start of the school day.
questions.explanation: A flag is a national symbol made of cloth that is raised on a pole.

questions.question: The U.S. flag has thirteen red and white stripes.
questions.explanation: True. The flag has 13 stripes representing the original 13 states.

questions.question: Taiwan is a beautiful _______ with friendly people and high mountains.
questions.explanation: Taiwan is a country, which is a land where people live together under one government.

questions.question: A seamstress is a person who builds stone houses.
questions.explanation: False. A seamstress is a person who sews clothes and cloth items.

questions.question: Hawaii became the fiftieth _______ to join the United States.
questions.explanation: Hawaii is the 50th state of the United States, represented by the 50th star on the flag.

questions.question: Please _______ the stars on the paper to find the total.
questions.hint: To say numbers one by one.
questions.explanation: To count means to say numbers in order to find how many items are present.

questions.question: Architects make drawings to _______ how a new house should look.
questions.explanation: To design is to plan and draw the appearance or structure of something.

questions.question: Sort these sentences based on whether they describe History/Governance or Shapes/Designs:
items: The stars are in a circle

categories.label: Shapes/Designs
answers: The stars are in a circle

questions.explanation: History, leaders making laws, and symbols relate to history/governance. Circles and rows describe geometric shapes and designs.

questions.question: The white stars on the blue field stand for the states of the country.
questions.explanation: True. In this context, 'stand for' means they represent the states.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe the blue part of the flag:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'The corner has a blue patch.' The stars are sewn on this patch.

questions.question: The class chose a student to be the _______ and guide the game.
questions.explanation: A leader is a person who guides or directs a group of people.

questions.question: When new students enter the class, they _______ the group.
questions.explanation: To join means to become a part or member of a group or class.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show what we do in history class:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'We can study the history.' Capitalize the first word.

questions.question: To join a club means to leave it and never go back.
questions.explanation: False. To join means to become a part of a club, which is the opposite of leaving.

questions.question: The red heart is a _______ that stands for love and kindness.
questions.explanation: A symbol is an object or picture that represents a special idea, like a heart for love.
